visual_argument: One lime link shows what an autonomous machine hands a human medic, working on the rubble, crossing smoke at night, split between two halves and open toward a dose, with every more than figure drawn to its floor and run off the frame.
build_risk: Frame 5 is a night frame in a win deck, so it must stay teal and violet and never black while a burst blooms and the link crosses smoke. A new tracked rover model must read as built hardware, not a box.
distinct_from_recent: Nov 20 drew a survey quad on a ridge, a frosted twin, a clay tablet and a loupe. Nov 19 drew sort glass, flies and a tube rack. Nov 18 drew a survey satellite and stake grids. None drew a ground robot, a night scene lit by a burst, brass stacks or a sectioned rubble pile.
